name: A-Identity
description: The passport and wallet for the agentic economy. On-chain agent identity (ERC-8004), x402 micro-payments, MCP-native tool access, and USDC settlement, live today on Circle Arc, with multi-chain identity planned across Base, Arbitrum, Avalanche, OKX X Layerand Stellar.

chains.note: No native ERC-8004 (EVM-only). Identity via Soroban registry / SEP-10; ERC-8004 passport bridged.
OKX.AI identity registry LIVE (read-side wired); payment rails still planned.
Canonical ERC-8004 identity + reputation registries are live here (deployed by their authors, not by us); agent #1259 is ours. No ValidationRegistry in this family, so KYA cannot be anchored here.
Identity + Reputation + Validation registries LIVE at the canonical cross-chain addresses.
Identity + Reputation registries LIVE (same canonical addresses as X Layer/Celo); agent #0, the registry's first mint, is ours (2026-08-12). No ValidationRegistry in the mainnet family yet.
Identity + Reputation registries LIVE (read-side wired). No ValidationRegistry on Celo yet, so KYA cannot be anchored on-chain there.
Identity + Reputation registries LIVE (same addresses as Arc). No ValidationRegistry, mirroring mainnet.

rails.name: Circle Arc (Testnet)
rails.role: Primary payment rail: gas in USDC, sub-second finality, App Kit unified balance.

rails.name: Stellar Testnet
rails.role: Fast, low-cost settlement: USDC + EURC native (Circle), Soroban contracts.

rails.name: OKX X Layer
rails.role: OKX.AI marketplace rail: identity reads live from OKX ERC-8004; x402 trust tools settle here.

rails.name: Base
rails.role: EVM fallback: ERC-8004 compatible, Coinbase ecosystem, low fees.

rails.name: Avalanche C-Chain
rails.role: Fast-finality EVM: native Circle USDC, low latency for burst settlement.

rails.name: Arbitrum One
rails.role: DeFi gateway: large protocol ecosystem, native Circle USDC, and our ERC-8004 agent #1259 on the canonical registry.

rails.name: Robinhood Chain Testnet
rails.role: Robinhood Chain rehearsal rail: the canonical ERC-8004 registry set is live here; mainnet waits on a human-funded signer.

rails.name: Robinhood Chain
rails.role: Robinhood's own L2 for tokenized real-world assets: canonical ERC-8004 identity + reputation live, agent #0 minted, and paid trust calls settling in USDG through our own first-party x402 facilitator.

rails.name: Celo
rails.role: Stablecoin-native EVM L2: ERC-8004 identity live, x402 USDC settlement via the first-party Celo facilitator, gas payable in stablecoins.

rails.name: Celo Sepolia (Testnet)
rails.role: Celo testnet rail (Alfajores is deprecated): same ERC-8004 registry pair as Arc, x402 USDC via the Sepolia facilitator.

reputation.source: settled x402 actions and ERC-8004 feedback

okx_ai_asp.positioning: the identity & reputation oracle for the agent economy

tools.name: resolve_agent
tools.input: query (CAIP-10 id, token id, address, domain)

tools.name: list_agents
tools.input: chain? (any registry chain id, e.g. arc|base|arbitrum|xlayer)
tools.returns: registered agents on that chain or all

tools.name: get_chain_status
tools.returns: every registry chain with its lifecycle status and agent counts

agent_to_agent.trust: Both agents verify each other via ERC-8004 before value moves. Reputation gate (default: 300+).
agent_to_agent.settlement: x402 in stablecoins on Arc, the live chain today; Celo (mainnet + Sepolia) settles via the first-party Celo facilitator in beta. Base is beta; Arbitrum, Avalancheand Stellar are planned. No shared accounts or API keys.

agent_to_human.trust: An agent presents its passport; the human sets limits and grants scoped permission.
agent_to_human.constraint: Payments above the auto-approve threshold pause for explicit human approval.

human_oversight: Actions that hold a key, deploy a contract, or move value require explicit human approval. A person stays in the tower; agents act inside the limits and policies the human sets. No autonomous key custody or mainnet contract deployment.
